jobs.description:
Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.
Department Overview

McDonald's is evolving its global marketing model to be more connected, efficient, and effective. As part of this effort, McDonald's is establishing a Future of Marketing team to define how marketing capabilities, processes, and ways of working will evolve over time. The team will help the business better leverage scale, improve consistency across markets, and strengthen the overall effectiveness of marketing investments.

Reporting to the Customer Engagement Tower Lead, the Future of Marketing: PSD – Customer Engagement: Owned Strategy (CRM) will support the design of future-state process workflows, RACI frameworks, and operating models for how McDonald's manages owned channel strategies and CRM capabilities across global and market teams.

The role requires solid knowledge of CRM, owned channel strategy, and customer lifecycle marketing, along with the ability to contribute to process design and documentation that enables consistent, scalable owned engagement across a complex, multi-market QSR environment.

Duties

- Support the design of end-to-end process workflows to deliver cohesive and integrated experiences across loyalty, owned experiences like app, kiosk and menu boards as well as CRM, including campaign planning, audience management, and lifecycle communications.

- Contribute to the development of RACI frameworks that define roles and decision rights across global, market, and technology teams for owned channels execution.

- Document current-state process gaps and inefficiencies and contribute to future-state solutions that improve consistency and speed.

- Partner with CRM, Loyalty, Martech, and Data to design f uture-state CRM process workflows that provide the foundation for scalable personalization and LTV optimization, in close partnership with Data, Insights, and Audience Strategy teams.

- Partner with CRM, Loyalty, Martech, and Data teams to ensure CRM process designs determine necessary technical capabilities and data availability to deliver owned experiences.

- Collaborate with the Global CRM and Martech teams to assess and determine requirements for best-in-class tools and systems

- Assist in developing governance standards for owned channel activation, including approval workflows and content governance.

- Collaborate with the Customer Engagement Tower Lead and PSD leads to ensure CRM process design is integrated with broader campaign and consumer experiences development processes.

- Support the development of process documentation and stakeholder communication materials.

Qualifications

- Solid experience in CRM, owned channel marketing, or customer lifecycle strategy within a marketing organization.

- Understanding of how owned channel processes & Audience strategy processes operate across global and market teams in a multi-market environment.

- Experience contributing to process design, documentation, or operating model work in a cross-functional setting.

- Familiarity with CRM and Loyalty platforms, marketing automation tools, and data-driven personalization approaches.

- Collaboration & Influence: Influences without direct authority; unites matrixed stakeholders around common goals.

- Navigating Ambiguity: Brings structure to the undefined; creates actionable frameworks from complex issues.

- Communication: Articulates complex strategies and "the why" to mid-to-senior level stakeholders.

- Prioritization & Workload: Prioritizes competing projects; balances immediate team workloads while keeping focus on strategic goals.

- Execution & Leadership: Strategic problem-solver; connects operational process to broader business outcomes

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Business Partner
jobs.description:
Company Description:

At McDonald's, we are committed to being the best, and that starts with finding the best people. We have built a team of extraordinary people from around the world. We are problem solvers, risk takers, innovators, and thought leaders that take our work seriously, but have fun doing it. We challenge ourselves to get smarter and sharper every day, we value personal and professional growth, and believe in rewarding and celebrating our successes.
The Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Manager, FP&A and Business Partnering, this role will be a key member of the Finance team and a trusted strategic partner to the Marketing organization. The Manager, Finance Business Partner (Marketing) will provide financial leadership and guidance to the Marketing Leadership Team and oversee the financial management of the National Marketing Forum (NMF) and Regional Marketing Forums (RMFs), ensuring sound financial stewardship, governance, and risk management.

The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the accounting activities of the NMF and RMFs through an external accounting partner, leading quarterly forecasting and financial planning processes, and coordinating the preparation and reporting of financial statements to lending institutions. The role also includes providing regular financial insights and recommendations to the Boards of Directors and Operator Leadership bodies.

Beyond the core responsibilities, this position offers the opportunity to serve as a Finance thought partner on national cross-functional initiatives and strategic projects, influencing key business decisions that support the growth and success of the McDonald's Canada system.

Key stakeholders include the CMO, the Marketing Leadership Team, Boards of Directors, financial institutions, external accounting partners, auditors, the CFO, and Operator Leadership teams.

Who you are

You are a proven financial leader who will be a key member of the Marketing and finance functions. You will support various levels of leadership, provide counsel and report to guide business decisions to move the team forward and make an impact on strategic initiatives. You have strong communication skills to effectively support the team in a fast paced and agile environment.

What’s in it for you?

This is an unparalleled opportunity to join a winning organization during an exciting time of transformational and accelerate growth. You will gain exposure across all levels of the organization, from your team members to the Executives and Franchisees. You are looking for a company with a winning culture where you can grow in depth and breadth while making a tangible impact on central initiatives.

Duties

In addition to following McDonald’s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic/Business Development

- Active member of the Marketing Leadership team in the development of short and long-term strategies

- Finance Lead within Marketing and for cross functional initiatives that impact the Marketing Forums

- Strategic business partnering with various stakeholders to optimize costs and maximize returns while supporting business priorities

- Oversight of risk management for Marketing Forums

- Engage and lead discussions with Marketing Forum Board of Directors on finance related matters and strengthen confidence in management of Marketing Forums financials

- Provide key strategic and financial oversight on cross function teams for special projects

Fiduciary Responsibility

- Overseeing the finances for the Marketing Forums which include compliance with accounting and reporting standards, maintaining financial controls and safeguarding the assets of the Marketing Forums

- Ensuring the financial health of the Marketing Forums including cash flow management

- Management of the Audit for the National and Regional Marketing Forum of Ontario

- Responsible for presenting the audited financial statements at the Annual General Meetings (“AGM”)

- Enhancing processes and ensuring adherences to guidelines and funding principles related to overall governance of the Marketing Forums

- Working with Stakeholders to develop the Annual Budget and providing projections to Marketing Leadership including Board of Directors

- Foster a culture of accountability with stakeholders as it relates to budget and expenditure management

People

- Foster an environment that supports and develops a high-performing team

- Responsible for educating stakeholders on understanding financial information, policies, procedures and governance

- Identifying and implementing process improvements to enable development of the team

- Manages key relationships with banks, suppliers and accounting firms to support the ongoing success of the Marketing Forums

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in related discipline with a CPA designation required.

- A minimum 5-7 years of relevant business experience.

- Dynamic interpersonal skills to develop strong relationships with key stakeholders and be an effective and strategic business partner

- Thrives in a dynamic and ever-changing environment, with the ability to adapt and shift priorities as required

- Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

- Solid influencing and strategic leadership skills.

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
McDonald's is veel meer dan restaurants alleen. Achter iedere nieuwe productlancering, prijsstrategie, marketingcampagne en operationele verbetering zit een organisatie die continu kijkt hoe het morgen nog beter kan. Als Manager Financial Planning & Analysis sta jij midden in die dynamiek. Je vertaalt data naar inzichten, inzichten naar keuzes en keuzes naar resultaat. Daarmee ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de CFO, het Leadership Team en collega's door de hele organisatie.

In deze rol werk je nauw samen met de CFO, het Leadership Team, Global Finance en collega's uit Marketing, Supply Chain, Technology en Operations. Ook vertegenwoordig je de Nederlandse markt binnen de Revenue Growth Management agenda en ben je lokaal verantwoordelijk voor pricing.
RUNNING GREAT RESTAURANTS BY GREAT PEOPLE

Wij staan voor oprechte aandacht voor onze gasten, persoonlijke ontwikkeling, innovatie en duurzame groei. Vanuit Finance draag jij hier direct aan bij. Als strategische sparringpartner voor de CFO ondersteun je de business met financiële inzichten die richting geven aan de toekomst van de organisatie.

INGREDIËNTEN VAN DEZE JOB

De rol van Manager FP&A is een McFlurry aan verantwoordelijkheden:

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor marktprognoses, scenarioanalyses en financiële projecties.

- Leidinggeven aan een klein team van financiële professionals hoort ook bij de rol, net als bijdragen aan hun ontwikkeling.

- Je beheert de financiële planning- en forecastcyclus en zorgt voor kwalitatieve en tijdige input voor besluitvorming.

- Samen met de CFO stel je marktplannen op, bespreek je de belangrijkste keuzes en zorg je voor afronding.

- Je werkt nauw samen met het BI-team en geeft feedback om tijdige, inzichtelijke rapportages, dashboards en analyses over omzet, gasten en marketingprestaties te realiseren.

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de prijsstrategie, prijsanalyses en samenwerkingen met leveranciers. Ondersteunt datagedreven prijsbeslissingen die een goede balans creëren tussen groei, gastwaarde en rendement voor franchisenemers.

- Je leidt de financiële rapportage en vertaalt resultaten naar heldere inzichten en concrete acties voor Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR's) en Market Reviews. Maakt complexe prestaties begrijpelijk en ondersteunt besluitvorming met sterke storytelling.

- Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling en beoordeling van business cases voor marktinitiatieven.

- In samenwerking met Finance en Financial Control werk je aan financiële rapportages, reviews en analyses.

- Business reviews, leadership meetings en andere strategische overlegmomenten ondersteun je met heldere financiële inzichten.

- Daarnaast voer je ad-hoc analyses uit en ondersteun je de organisatie bij complexe financiële vraagstukken.

DOORGROEIMOGELIJKHEDEN

Deze rol is stevig verankerd in Nederland, maar speelt zich af binnen een internationale omgeving met veel contact met Segment en Global Finance. Bij McDonald's is persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk. Heb jij de ambitie en het potentieel om verder te groeien, dan zijn er volop mogelijkheden binnen Finance, richting een bredere leiderschapsrol binnen de business of binnen een internationale context.

Met jouw bijdrage creëer je nieuwe kansen voor de organisatie, maar ook voor jezelf. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het Finance team van ruim 20 collega's en werkt dagelijks dicht op de business, de CFO en het Leadership Team.

JOUW MENU

Wij zoeken een collega die energie krijgt van impact maken. Iemand die met scherpe analyses, heldere inzichten en duidelijke keuzes de business écht verder helpt. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen detail en strategie, tussen lokaal en global en tussen Finance en de rest van de organisatie.

Je staat stevig in je advies, maar weet mensen mee te nemen met een open, verbindende stijl. Met energie, humor en een goed gevoel voor storytelling vertaal jij cijfers naar keuzes die richting geven. Analytisch sterk, business-minded en comfortabel in stakeholdermanagement: dat is wat jij meebrengt.

- Academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Finance, Business, Economie, Econometrie of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Minimaal 5 tot 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen Finance, FP&A of vergelijkbare financiële functies.

- Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team.

- Sterk begrip van P&L dynamiek, forecasting, planning, business cases en performance management.

- Ervaring met data, reporting en analytics tools; je weet het verschil tussen rapporteren en echt inzicht geven.

- Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het presenteren aan senior stakeholders.

- Ervaring met pricing, Revenue Growth Management, retail, QSR, FMCG of franchiseorganisaties is een pre.

- Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

ONS MENU

- Een jaarcontract voor 40 uur per week

- De mogelijkheid jouw werkzaamheden gedeeltelijk vanuit huis te verrichten in combinatie met een goed thuiswerkbeleid (inrichting werkplek thuis en thuiswerkvergoeding)

- Volop ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden

- 30 vakantiedagen plus een jaarlijkse persoonlijke verlofdag, die je helemaal naar eigen wens kunt gebruiken.

- Een moderne mobiliteitsregeling waaronder een NS-business card om van en naar kantoor te reizen

- Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling

- Premievrij pensioen

- Een iPhone en laptop om je werkzaamheden uit te voeren

- Een prachtig kantoor direct naast Utrecht Centraal met heerlijke koffie en vers fruit

Daarnaast bieden wij een salarisrange van  € 6.371,00  tot  € 7.964,00   bruto per maand  (exclusief 8% vakantiegeld). De uiteindelijke inschaling is afhankelijk van de kennis en ervaring die je meebrengt.

ONZE WAARDEN

Bij McDonald's zien we elke dag als een kans om een positieve impact te creëren. We leiden door onze waarden: Servicegericht, Inclusiviteit, Integriteit, Goede Buur en Partners.

Van het ondersteunen van de Ronald McDonald Huizen tot onze duurzaamheidsinitiatieven: onze waarden helpen ons om onze schaalgrootte op een positieve manier in te zetten.

- Delivering performance analysis, insights and reporting that inform commercial decisions

- Providing day-to-day financial advice and support to franchisees, resolving queries with pace and professionalism

- Contributing to margin improvement, cost optimisation and capital allocation strategies

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - you can turn financial data into insight people act on

- Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail

- Proven ability to develop and influence strategic initiatives and outcomes

- CPA or CA qualified (or working towards), with 3+ years' experience in commercial or field finance roles preferred

- A Fun & Vibrant Culture.  Immerse yourself in local and Macca’s only events and experiences from day one of working with us.

At Macca’s, our doors are open to everyone, and we live by our Golden Rule: treating everyone with dignity, fairness and respect, always. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive and welcoming workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered - it’s our people who make us Macca’s.
